note: Shared glossary for all parts (fitts) of Beowulf. Entries keyed by word form as printed in Klaeber 1922, lowercased, editorial brackets/parentheses stripped. Lemma — meaning (grammatical info).

glossary.hwæt: hwæt — what! lo! (interjection calling for attention; also the pronoun 'what')
glossary.gār-dena: Gār-Dene — of the Spear-Danes (genitive plural; gār 'spear' + Dene 'Danes')
glossary.gēardagum: gēardagas — in days of yore (dative plural; gēar 'year' + dagas 'days')
glossary.þēodcyninga: þēodcyning — of the people-kings (genitive plural; þēod 'people, nation' + cyning 'king')
glossary.gefrūnon: gefrignan — (we) have heard of, learned by inquiry (1st plural preterite)
glossary.ðā: sē/þā — the, those (nominative plural of the demonstrative); as adverb: then · þā — those, the (accusative plural of the demonstrative) · þā — when (conjunction; ðā ic of searwum cwōm 'when I came from') · þā — then (adverb; nū ðā 'just now')
glossary.ellen: ellen — courage, valor, mighty deeds (accusative singular) · ellen — courage, valor (nominative singular neuter, subject of dēah)
glossary.scyld: Scyld — Scyld, mythical founder of the Danish royal house (nominative) · scyld — shield (accusative singular masculine; sīdne scyld 'broad shield')
glossary.meodosetla: meodosetl — of mead-seats, mead-benches (genitive plural, object of oftēah; medu 'mead' + setl 'seat')
glossary.oftēah: oftēon — took away, deprived of (3rd singular preterite; takes a genitive object)
glossary.eorlas: eorl — warriors, nobles (accusative plural; the MS reads 'eorl' — the ending is Klaeber's emendation, hence the brackets)
glossary.syððan: siþþan — after, since, from the time when (conjunction)
glossary.wearð: weorðan — became, was (3rd singular preterite; auxiliary of the passive: 'was found')
glossary.þæs: þæt — for that, of that (genitive singular of the demonstrative: 'comfort for that') · se — of the (genitive singular neuter article, before a noun: þæs recedes 'of the hall') · þes — this (demonstrative, nominative singular masculine; the manuscript's þæs for þes, in þæs sele 'this hall')
glossary.frōfre: frōfor — comfort, consolation, help (feminine; genitive/dative/accusative singular)
glossary.gebād: gebīdan — experienced, lived to see (3rd singular preterite; takes the genitive)
glossary.wolcnum: wolcen — under the clouds, the skies (dative plural; cf. archaic English 'welkin')
glossary.weorðmyndum: weorðmynd — in honors, marks of esteem (dative plural)
glossary.him: hē — to him, or to them (dative singular or plural of hē) · hē — to himself, for themselves (reflexive dative, pleonastic: gewiton him 'they went off') · hē — to it (neuter dative singular; hīe him tō 'they to it')

glossary.hȳran: hȳran — to obey, hearken to (infinitive; takes the dative)
glossary.scolde: sculan — had to, was obliged to (3rd singular preterite) · sculan — should, were to (3rd singular preterite subjunctive in a condition; gyf ... scolde 'if ... should')
glossary.gomban: gombe — tribute (accusative singular; a rare, old word)
glossary.wæs: wesan — was (3rd singular preterite) · wesan — be (imperative singular; Wæs þū hāl 'be hale', a greeting)

glossary.geong: geong — young (adjective; in line 20 restored — the MS is burned, only '…uma' survives)
glossary.geardum: geard — in the courts, dwellings (dative plural; geard 'yard, enclosure' — cf. middangeard 'middle-earth')

glossary.folce: folc — to the folk, people (dative singular)

glossary.ongeat: ongietan — perceived, understood, had seen (3rd singular preterite)

glossary.hīe: hīe — they (nominative plural) · hīe — them (accusative plural)

glossary.gōde: gōd — good (here the noun: 'with good, by good action', dative singular)
glossary.gewyrcean: gewyrcan — to bring about, achieve, earn (infinitive)

glossary.hine: hē — him (accusative singular) · hē — himself (reflexive accusative singular; hylde hine 'laid himself down')
glossary.ylde: yldo — old age (dative singular; on ylde 'in old age')
glossary.gewunigen: gewunian — may remain with, stand by (3rd plural present subjunctive)
glossary.wilgesīþas: wilgesīþ — willing companions (nominative plural; willa 'goodwill, desire' + gesīþ 'companion')

glossary.wīg: wīg — war, battle (nominative singular) · wīg — war, battle (accusative singular neuter; object of gesēcean)
glossary.cume: cuman — may come (3rd singular present subjunctive)

glossary.gehwǣre: gehwā — in each (dative singular feminine; mǣgþa gehwǣre 'in each of tribes')

glossary.gewāt: gewītan — departed, went (3rd singular preterite; him gewāt 'took himself off')
glossary.gescæphwīle: gescæphwīl — the shaped hour, appointed time of death (dative singular; gesceap 'destiny, what is shaped' + hwīl 'time')

glossary.tēodan: tēon — furnished, provided, adorned (3rd plural preterite)

glossary.þēnode: þēnian — serve (1st singular preterite; takes the dative; cf. 'thane', 'thegn')
glossary.ācwæð: ācweþan — speak, utter (3rd singular preterite; ā- + cweþan; cf. 'quoth')
glossary.āhlǣcan: āhlǣca — awesome one, fearsome assailant (weak masculine; dative singular; a variant of ǣglǣca)
glossary.ālamp: ālimpan — come to pass, happen (3rd singular preterite)
glossary.ālȳfde: ālȳfan — grant, entrust, allow (1st singular preterite; takes the dative of the person)
glossary.ānunga: ānunga — wholly, utterly, altogether (adverb; from ān 'one')
glossary.ārað: ārian — spare, show mercy (3rd singular present; takes the dative; related to ār 'mercy')
glossary.āswefede: āswebban — put to sleep, kill (past participle, nominative plural masculine; ā- + swebban; cf. swefeð)
glossary.ēgstrēamum: ēgstrēam — sea-stream, ocean current (dative plural; ēg 'water' + strēam 'stream')
glossary.ēowra: ēower — your (possessive adjective, genitive plural; from gē 'you')
glossary.ēþelwearde: ēþelweard — guardian of the homeland (dative singular masculine; ēþel 'homeland' + weard 'guard')
glossary.ōþerne: ōþer — other, second (accusative singular masculine; cf. 'other')
glossary.ǣfenræste: ǣfenræst — evening rest, bed (feminine; accusative singular; ǣfen 'evening' + ræst 'rest')
glossary.ǣghwylcne: ǣghwilc — each, every (accusative singular masculine; agrees with dǣl)
glossary.ȳðlāfe: ȳðlāf — leaving of the waves, shore (feminine; dative singular; ȳð 'wave' + lāf 'remnant')

glossary.andan: anda — anger, malice, enmity (weak masculine, dative singular)
glossary.andwlitan: andwlita — face, countenance (weak masculine, accusative singular; and- 'against' + wlitan 'to look')
glossary.beadwa: beadu — battle (feminine, genitive plural; beadwa geþinges 'the outcome of battles')

glossary.bregdan: bregdan — drag, pull, move with a sudden motion (infinitive; strong verb; cf. 'braid')
glossary.cynnes: cynn — kind, race, kin (neuter, genitive singular; manna cynnes 'of mankind'; cf. 'kin')
glossary.cyst: cyst — the best, choice, pick (feminine, accusative singular; with the genitive: īrena cyst 'the choicest of irons')
glossary.cūþ: cūþ — known (adjective, past participle of cunnan; nominative singular neuter, with dative of the person; cf. 'uncouth')
glossary.dear: durran — dare (3rd singular present; preterite-present verb; gif hē dear 'if he dare')
glossary.denigea: Denige — Danes (genitive plural; a longer by-form of Dene; Denigea lēode 'people of the Danes')
glossary.dryhten: dryhten — lord (masculine, nominative singular; a title of God, 'the Lord'; from dryht 'troop')
glossary.dēme: dēman — judge, decree, assign (3rd singular present subjunctive; weak verb; cf. 'deem')
glossary.eardlufan: eardlufu — home-love, love of one's dwelling (weak feminine, accusative singular; eard 'homeland' + lufu 'love')
glossary.eodur: eodor — enclosure, fence; protector (masculine, nominative singular, in apposition to a king; the Old English word for the 'fence' that guards a people)
glossary.eorles: eorl — earl, nobleman, warrior (masculine, genitive singular)
glossary.eotonweard: eotonweard — giant-guard, guard against giants (masculine, case uncertain: a bare accusative, or the dative eotonwearde with its final e elided before ā- as Klaeber's apostrophe suggests; eoten 'giant' + weard 'guardian'; the sense is a guess)
glossary.frēoburh: frēoburg — noble city, stronghold (feminine, accusative singular; frēo 'free, noble' + burh 'fortified place')

glossary.fultum: fultum — help, support (masculine, accusative singular; from full + tēam 'full band')
glossary.gebeddan: gebedda — bedfellow, consort (weak noun, dative singular; tō gebeddan 'as bedfellow')

glossary.gefrungon: gefrignan — learn by asking, hear tell (3rd plural preterite; strong verb; ge- + frignan 'to ask'; swā guman gefrungon 'as men heard tell')

glossary.gehealdan: gehealdan — keep, hold, guard (infinitive; ge- + healdan; cf. 'hold')
glossary.gehēawe: gehēawan — hew, cut, strike (3rd singular present subjunctive; strong verb; ge- + hēawan; cf. 'hew')
glossary.gemet: gemet — fitting, suitable (predicate adjective, nominative singular neuter, or the neuter noun 'measure, fitness' used predicatively; which is uncertain; swā him gemet þince 'as seems fitting to him')
glossary.gespræc: gesprecan — spoke (3rd singular preterite; strong verb; ge- + sprecan; cf. 'speak')
glossary.gesēcean: gesēcan — seek out, go to, attack (infinitive; weak verb; ge- + sēcan 'seek')
glossary.gewiofu: gewiofu — web, woven fabric (neuter, accusative plural; the 'web' of destiny woven for men)
glossary.gylpworda: gylpword — boast, boastful speech (neuter, genitive plural; partitive after sum; gylp 'boast' + word)
glossary.gūþgeweorca: gūþgeweorc — battle-work, deed of war (neuter, genitive plural; gūþ 'battle' + geweorc 'work'; genitive of respect)
glossary.hafelan: hafela — head (weak masculine, dative singular; the weak form beside heafod; cf. 'head')
glossary.heaþodēor: heaþodēor — battle-bold, brave in war (adjective, nominative singular masculine, used as a noun; heaþo 'war' + dēor 'bold, fierce')
glossary.heora: hē — their, of them (genitive plural of hē, a form of hiera; used both possessively and partitively)
glossary.herewæsmun: herewæstm — war-strength, martial prowess (masculine, dative plural with -un for -um, or possibly dative singular; a word found only here; here 'army' + wæstm 'growth, stature')
glossary.hildegeatwe: hildegeatwe — battle-gear, war-equipment (feminine plural, accusative; hild 'battle' + geatwe 'equipment')
glossary.hlēorbolster: hlēorbolster — cheek-pillow (masculine, nominative singular; hlēor 'cheek' + bolster 'pillow')
glossary.hnāgran: hnāh — low, inferior (adjective, weak comparative, accusative or dative singular; agrees with the reflexive mē; the comparative is followed by þonne 'than')
glossary.hornreced: hornreced — horned hall, gabled hall (neuter, accusative singular; horn 'gable-horn' + reced 'building, hall')
glossary.hylde: hyldan — bowed, inclined, lay down (3rd singular preterite; weak verb; hylde hine 'laid himself down')
glossary.hyldo: hyldo — favor, grace, protection (feminine, nominative or accusative singular, a dative being hylde; taken as accusative after the verb of trusting, in parallel with mægnes, though the construction is irregular)
glossary.hyrsted: hyrsted — adorned, ornamented (past participle as adjective, accusative singular neuter; from hyrstan 'to adorn')
glossary.kyningwuldor: cyningwuldor — King of glory, glorious king (neuter, nominative singular; cyning 'king' + wuldor 'glory'; a title of God)
glossary.leōdum: lēod — man, member of a people; (plural) people (masculine, dative plural)
glossary.metodes: Metod — the Measurer, God (masculine, genitive singular; from metan 'to measure, mete out')
glossary.micles: micel — great, much (adjective, genitive singular neuter, probably of degree, 'by much': tō fela micles 'far too many'; cf. 'much, mickle')
glossary.mihtum: miht — might, power (feminine, dative plural, instrumental; cf. 'might')
glossary.mæge: magan — can, be able (1st singular present subjunctive, concessive after þēah; preterite-present verb; cf. 'may')
glossary.mægnes: mægen — strength, might (neuter, genitive singular; the object of trūwian is put in the genitive)
glossary.mōdgan: mōdig — proud, spirited, high-hearted (adjective, weak genitive singular neuter, agreeing with mægnes; cf. 'moody')
glossary.mǣrðo: mǣrðu — glory, glorious deed (feminine, accusative plural)
glossary.nelle: nyllan — be unwilling, will not (1st singular present; contraction of ne + willan)
glossary.nolde: nyllan — would not, did not wish (3rd singular preterite; contraction of ne + wolde)
glossary.nīþgeweorca: nīþgeweorc — deed of hate, hostile work (neuter, genitive plural; nīð 'hate, enmity' + geweorc; genitive of respect after rōf)
glossary.ofercōmon: ofercuman — overcome, overpower (3rd plural preterite; strong verb; ofer + cuman)
glossary.ofersittan: ofersittan — forbear, refrain from, let pass (infinitive; strong verb, 'sit over'; takes the dative)
glossary.ombihtþegne: ombihtþegn — attendant, servant (masculine, dative singular; ombiht 'service, office' + þegn 'thane, retainer')
glossary.ongēan: ongēan — against, towards, in return (adverb or preposition; following its pronoun: mē ongēan 'at me')
glossary.rand: rand — shield (masculine, accusative singular; originally 'rim, edge' of a shield)
glossary.rōf: rōf — brave, strong, renowned (adjective, nominative singular masculine; takes the genitive)
glossary.sceadu: sceadu — shadow, darkness (feminine, accusative, singular or plural; under sceadu 'beneath the shadows'; cf. 'shade')
glossary.sceadugenga: sceadugenga — shadow-walker (weak masculine, nominative singular; sceadu 'shadow' + genga 'goer')
glossary.sculon: sculan — shall, must, be obliged to (1st plural present, with the dual subject wit 'we two'; cf. 'shall')
glossary.scynscaþa: scynscaþa — demon-foe, evil ravager (weak masculine, nominative singular; scyn 'evil spirit' + scaþa 'harmer, foe'; the editor supplies the c)
glossary.scēotend: scēotend — shooter, archer, warrior (masculine, nominative plural; agent noun from scēotan 'to shoot')
glossary.selereste: selerest — hall-bed, resting-place in a hall (feminine, dative or accusative singular, the forms coinciding; sele 'hall' + rest)
glossary.seleweard: seleweard — hall-guard (masculine, accusative singular; sele 'hall' + weard 'guardian')
glossary.selfes: self — self, own (pronoun/adjective, genitive singular masculine; selfes mihtum 'by his own might')
glossary.siê: wesan — be (3rd singular present subjunctive, spelled siê for sīe; concessive after þēah ðe)
glossary.sleâ: slēan — strike, smite (3rd singular present subjunctive, spelled sleâ; strong verb; cf. 'slay')
glossary.snellīc: snellīc — bold, keen, valiant (adjective, nominative singular masculine; snell 'bold' + -līc)
glossary.stige: stīgan — climb, mount, step (3rd singular preterite subjunctive (short i, as against present stīge), after ǣr; strong verb; cf. 'stair')
glossary.sundọrnytte: sundornytt — special service, particular office (feminine, accusative singular; sundor 'apart, special' + nytt 'use, service'; the dot is Klaeber's metrical sign)
glossary.swebban: swebban — put to sleep, lull; kill (infinitive; weak verb)
glossary.swǣfon: swefan — sleep (3rd plural preterite; strong verb)
glossary.sēcan: sēcan — seek, go to, visit (infinitive; weak verb; cf. 'seek')
glossary.sǣrinc: sǣrinc — sea-warrior (masculine, nominative singular; sǣ 'sea' + rinc 'man, warrior')
glossary.trūwọde: trūwian — trust, have confidence in (3rd singular preterite; weak verb; takes the genitive or dative; the dot is Klaeber's metrical sign)
glossary.tōgēanes: tōgēanes — against, towards, to meet (preposition with dative, or adverb; following its noun: Grendle tōgēanes 'against Grendel')
glossary.wanre: wann — dark, dusky (adjective, dative singular feminine; cf. 'wan')
glossary.wealhþēo: Wealhþēow — Wealhtheow, queen of the Danes, wife of Hrothgar (accusative)
glossary.wæccende: wæccan — wake, be awake, keep watch (present participle, nominative singular masculine; cf. 'watch')
glossary.wældēað: wældēað — death in slaughter, violent death (masculine, nominative singular; wæl 'slaughter' + dēað 'death')
glossary.wīdeferhð: wīdeferhð — for a long lifetime, always (adverb, from an accusative of duration; wīd 'wide' + ferhð 'life, spirit')
glossary.wīgfruma: wīgfruma — war-chief, battle-leader (weak masculine, nominative singular; wīg 'war' + fruma 'beginning, leader')
glossary.wīgspēda: wīgspēd — success in war, victory (feminine, genitive plural; wīg 'war' + spēd 'success')
glossary.wīnsele: wīnsele — wine-hall, banqueting hall (masculine, dative singular; wīn 'wine' + sele 'hall')
glossary.wītig: wītig — wise, knowing (adjective, nominative singular masculine; from witan 'to know'; cf. 'witty')
glossary.ðurh: þurh — through, by means of (preposition with accusative; spelled ðurh; cf. 'through')
glossary.þince: þyncan — seem, appear (3rd singular present subjunctive; impersonal, with dative of the person; cf. 'methinks')
glossary.þōhte: þencan — think, intend, expect (3rd singular preterite; weak verb; cf. 'think')
glossary.āfēded: āfēdan — bring up, rear, nourish (past participle; weak verb; ā- + fēdan 'feed')
glossary.ānes: ān — one, a single (numeral adjective, genitive singular masculine; cf. 'one')
glossary.ānum: ān — one (numeral adjective, dative singular masculine, used as a noun: 'one man')
glossary.āseted: āsettan — set, place, appoint (past participle; weak verb; ā- + settan; agrees with the object)
glossary.īrena: īren — iron, iron weapon, sword (neuter, genitive plural)
glossary.īsernbyrnan: īsernbyrne — iron mail-coat (weak feminine, accusative singular or plural; īsern 'iron' + byrne 'corslet')
